name: Vikas N Dhavande
title: Product Engineer | Embedded Systems & Avionics Specialist
bio: Specializing in aerospace avionics, embedded control subsystems, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) automated test engineering, and IPC-standard electronics manufacturing.

experiences.description: Contributing to the electronics development of a critical national aerospace project, engineering high-reliability avionics subsystems and control modules.
highlights: Architecting instrumentation and designing Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation environments to validate hardware behavior prior to deployment
Developing automated test scripts in MATLAB, LabVIEW, Python, and C++ based on rigorous R&D requirements to verify system performance and catch edge-case failures
Documenting detailed test results and failure patterns to build a research knowledge base, providing data-driven feedback to optimize design iterations

experiences.description: Contributed to the electronics design and embedded subsystems of a critical national aerospace project at India's premier research institution.
highlights: Designed high-reliability avionics subsystems, sensor interfaces, and embedded control modules
Developed custom instrumentation and configured HIL simulation testbeds for hardware validation
Authored automated verification scripts in Python, LabVIEW, and C++ for system compliance

experiences.company: Bosch Automotive Electronics India Pvt. Ltd.
experiences.description: Partnered with New Product Introduction (NPI) and Engineering Change Request (ECR) teams to validate automotive electronics, specifically ECUs, BCUs, and DCDC converters for mass production.
highlights: Executed component-level testing using In-Circuit Test (ICT) and Flying Probe Test (FPT) systems
Analyzed and debugged complex test failures to identify root causes (RCA) and prevent defective units from advancing
Enforced strict quality compliance (IPC-A-610), segregating defective units and validating fixes to achieve 100% defect-free releases

experiences.company: Bosch Automotive Electronics India Pvt. Ltd.
experiences.description: Coordinated Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) across cross-functional departments, ensuring smooth implementation without disrupting production.
highlights: Interpreted complex Engineering Drawings and BOMs to plan execution trials and validate test setups for new product variants
Utilized SAP-PP and SAP-MM modules to plan trial runs, managing material availability and execution timelines
Maintained audit-ready technical documentation of ECR activities and plant compliance

experiences.description: Operated high-speed SMT lines for Main Logic Board (MLB) manufacturing, a critical component for high-performance consumer electronics.
highlights: Managed and calibrated Pick and Place, Screen Printer, Solder Paste Inspection (SPI), and Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) machines
Monitored real-time production telemetry to detect solder defects and component misalignments
Maintained strict global IPC manufacturing standards for high-throughput SMT lines
